Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 
in the title block
The first draft 
is initiated and tested by eng. Alaa Ibrahim Elshal, 
revised by eng. Aly Abd El-Gelil , reviewed by EDEPC quality control 
eng. Abdel Menem Alemam, accepted by I & C dept manager eng. Mohamad 
Ellawindi and approved by eng. Mohammad Elsarag head sector of 
Demiatta CCPS
This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector.
Components
Two processing and control boards type R16 for on 
load control through HP & LP inlets.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Tools and Equipment
Digital multi meter, screw driver
Wire connection.
Micro console MP 11, bailey.

Wire connection.

Work to be Carried Out
Cleaning all cards.
Check tighten all 
connections & wiring.
Connect the socket of the 
micro console to the first card (HP).
Code 00 
←I
(enter).
Show the data in raise 
order by enter (val) ←I
(enter).
Comprise the present value 
to the one of the manual.
For any remarkable 
deviation of the two readings enter (var) 
←I
(enter).
Then enter the right value.
Continuous until the 
procedure is end.
Repeat steps from 4 to 8 
for the 2 nd. card ( R16).
Close the work order.
